summary: E2E test of the new Tekrarlı Hatırlatıcı (recurring reminder) feature across all three surfaces (create form / edit modal / right-click context menu). Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (create+patch+clear+dirty-flag regression via /api/tasks). Frontend: 8/8 scenarios passed via Playwright as ahmet on the preview URL. Feature works end-to-end — create-form specific-time (T1) and relative 'Sonra başla' (T2) persist reminder_at + reminder_interval_min + reminder_repeat_total correctly; regression check (T3) confirms plain create leaves all reminder fields null; edit modal (T4) writes the fields; edit dirty-flag (T5) confirms editing only the title does NOT accidentally arm a reminder; context-menu free-form interval (T6) correctly stores 2 gün → 2880 min with repeat=4 through the ctx-reminder-1h preset; single (non-recurring) context-menu preset (T7) preserves original behavior (no interval, no repeat); the independent 'Yaklaşan Uyarısı' reminder-days select (T8) still works alongside recurring controls. Interval fields conditionally render only when count>1 in both create form and context menu — verified with is_visible() before/after count change.

features_verified.backend_create_recurring_reminder_at: PASS — POST /api/tasks with reminder_at + reminder_interval_min=15 + reminder_repeat_total=20 persists correctly; GET verify OK.
features_verified.backend_create_no_reminder_regression: PASS — plain create returns reminder_at=null, interval=null, repeat=null.
features_verified.backend_patch_adds_recurring: PASS — PATCH populates all four recurring fields.
features_verified.backend_patch_title_only_dirty_flag: PASS — PATCH with only {title} does NOT modify reminder_at/interval/repeat (exclude_unset works).
features_verified.backend_patch_explicit_null_clears: PASS — PATCH with reminder_at:null clears all recurring fields.
features_verified.frontend_T1_create_form_specific_time: PASS — checkbox reveals fields; interval fields show only when count>1; task persists reminder_interval_min=15, reminder_repeat_total=20, reminder_at set.
features_verified.frontend_T2_create_form_relative_sonra_b: PASS — 'Sonra başla' 2 saat sonra with count=3 + 30 dakika interval → reminder_at ≈ now+2h (0.0 min diff), interval=30, repeat=3.
features_verified.frontend_T3_create_no_reminder_regressio: PASS — checkbox off → task created with all reminder fields null.
features_verified.frontend_T4_edit_modal_recurring: PASS — edit-reminder-recurring-enabled + edit-reminder-at-input + edit-reminder-count=5 + 1 saat → interval=60, repeat=5, reminder_at set.
features_verified.frontend_T5_edit_dirty_flag_regression: PASS — editing only edit-title on a no-reminder task does NOT arm reminder (reminder_at stays null).
features_verified.frontend_T6_context_menu_free_form_inter: PASS — ctx-reminder-interval-amount hidden when repeat=1, appears at repeat>1; setting 2 gün + repeat=4 + preset ctx-reminder-1h persisted interval_min=2880, repeat_total=4, reminder_at set.
features_verified.frontend_T7_context_menu_single_preset: PASS — repeat left at 1 (interval fields correctly hidden); ctx-reminder-30m stores reminder_at with interval=null, repeat_total=null.
features_verified.frontend_T8_reminder_days_independent: PASS — task-reminder-days-select in create form still writes reminder_days=3 independently of recurring controls; reminder_at remains null.

critical_code_review_comments: RecurringReminderFields.jsx conditional interval render (count>1) is clean and consistent across create + edit + ctx menu — good shared component.
reminderUtils.resolveRecurringReminder correctly sets intervalMin=null when count===1, so single-shot reminders round-trip through the backend as before (Task 7 verified).
Backend PATCH uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) which correctly implements the dirty-flag semantics — regression T5 confirmed no leak.

In the context menu path, the free-form interval (intervalAmount+intervalUnit) is only forwarded when repeatCount>1 (TaskContextMenu.jsx lines 408, 439). Preset fallback intervalMin still applies for repeat=1 — matches spec.

seed_data_creation: Test tasks TEST_recur_at_*, TEST_recur_in_*, TEST_no_rem_*, TEST_T4/T5/T6/T7/T8_* created and cleaned up via DELETE after each run. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recurring reminder feature is stable across all 3 surfaces. Testids to know: RecurringReminderFields uses testPrefix — new-task-reminder-* in create (TasksPanel.jsx), edit-reminder-* in edit modal (EditTaskModal.jsx). Context menu uses ctx-reminder-repeat, ctx-reminder-interval-amount, ctx-reminder-interval-unit. Interval fields render ONLY when count>1. Frontend token stored in localStorage['sertex_token_v1'] (NOT 'token'). Right-clicks in Playwright work reliably via page.locator(sel).click(button='right', force=True) after scroll_into_view_if_needed — bounding_box+mouse.click had misses when tasks were far down the scrollable list.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions or bugs found. Feature implementation aligns with spec.
